  Salary:  Competitive salary offer + Benefits 

  Location:  All Sydney NSW 

 About the Company: 

 Our clients has a team of allied health professionals providing in-clinic and mobile services in Occupational Therapy and Speech Therapy to support their local communities. They provide therapy services to all ages. Their team comprises experienced Bilingual/Trilingual Therapists who are passionate about supporting families who speak English as a second language. They pride themselves on delivering high-quality therapy to the community, and we understand that every individual’s journey is different. They want to support you along the way to achieve the best of your abilities! 

 About the Role: 

 Are you a passionate and experienced  Occupational Therapist  looking to make a difference in the lives of others? They are currently seeking a motivated and experienced Occupational Therapist to join their team. In this role, you will be responsible for providing therapy services to a variety of clients, including children and adults. You will develop and implement individualized treatment plans and work closely with clients and their families to help them achieve their goals. 

 Key Responsibilities: 

 
	 
	 Conduct initial evaluations and assessments to determine the patient’s needs and goals. 
	 
	 
	 Develop individualized treatment plans tailored to the patient’s needs and goals. 
	 
	 
	 Implement treatment plans using evidence-based interventions. 
	 
	 
	 Monitor and adjust treatment plans as necessary. 
	 
	 
	 Educate clients and their families on therapy processes and techniques. 
	 
	 
	 Maintain accurate and timely documentation of client progress. 
	 
	 
	 Collaborate with other healthcare professionals to ensure coordinated care. 
	 
	 
	 Provide ongoing support and encouragement to clients throughout their therapy journey. 
	 
 

 Essential Criteria: 

 
	 
	 Bachelor's or Master's degree in  Occupational Therapy . 
	 
	 
	 Current registration with  AHPRA  (Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency). 
	 
	 
	 Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
	 
	 
	 Strong organizational and time-management skills. 
	 
	 
	 Access to a vehicle and a valid driver’s license. 
	 
 

 If you are passionate about making a positive impact in the lives of individuals and families through high-quality therapy, we would love to hear from you! Apply today and be part of our dynamic and supportive team.   Apply Now

Permanent Geologist role in Mudgee offering strong career growth, a residential Monday-Friday lifestyle.  Your New Company    An established mining operation is developing a significant project in Central NSW, approximately three hours from Sydney. This site offers long term stability within a growing mining and exploration environment        Your New Role    As a Geologist, you will play a key role in supporting exploration, project development, and future mining activities. This is a hands on, site based Monday to Friday role focused on geological interpretation, data management, modelling, and drilling support.        Your responsibilities will include:   
 
 Collecting, interpreting, and validating geological, geochemical, and drilling data 
 Developing and maintaining 3D geological models and resource interpretations 
 Supporting the design and execution of exploration and drilling programs (logging, sampling, mapping) 
 Ensuring data quality control and database integrity for accurate reporting and resource estimation 
 Preparing technical reports and documentation for internal stakeholders 
 Assisting in identifying exploration targets and resource growth opportunities 
 Contributing to a project transitioning from exploration into development and mining operations 
 
     Field based duties (where applicable):   
 
 Core logging (lithology, structure, mineralisation) 
 Drill program support, contractor coordination, and site supervision 
 Geological mapping and field investigations 
 Geochemical sampling and interpretation 
 
     What You'll Get In Return     This permanent, long term opportunity offers the chance to gain exposure across both exploration and mining geology as the operation develops, while working within a supportive team environment and enjoying the lifestyle benefit of returning home each night.            What You'll Need to Succeed   
 
 Degree in Geology (Bachelor of Science - Honours preferred) 
 Experience in mining or exploration geology (hard rock / minerals preferred) 
 Exposure to metals highly regarded (candidates from coal must demonstrate transferable knowledge) 
 Strong technical capability in geological interpretation and data analysis 
 Good physical fitness and strong work ethic 
 Current manual driver's licence 
 Ability to pass pre-employment medical and drug & alcohol screening 
 First Aid certification (desirable) 
 
         What You Need to Do Now    If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to Mtisa@hays.com.au, or call us now on 07 4749 8399.    Please  click here  to apply.

Your new company    A growing Managed Service Provider in Melbourne's South-East requires a Senior Security Engineer for a permanent opportunity commencing ASAP. The company promotes a collaborative and supportive work environment, offering exposure to leading technologies and excellent career development opportunities. 
   Your new role    Within this challenging and rewarding position, you will be responsible for: 
 
 Maintaining and improving IT infrastructure. 
 Undertaking Infrastructure upgrades, migrations and project delivery. 
 Leading / assisting with ISO compliance activities 
 Supporting a broad range of cybersecurity initiatives (i.e. MFA implementation, endpoint protection, security monitoring, risk assessments, etc) 
 Identifying opportunities for automation and operational efficiency. 
 
   What you'll need to succeed    To be successful in this role, you will have: 
 
 Proven experience working in a Managed Service Provider. 
 Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Azure, VMware / Hyper-V, Active Directory and Networking. 
 Sound understanding of risk management, security controls, policy development, audit preparation and compliance reporting. 
 Highly developed troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
 A tertiary education in Information Technology, alongside Azure, Microsoft, ISO27001 and CompTIA Security+ certifications are beneficial. 
 A current driver's license and vehicle.

result.description:
Australian Fishing Enterprises (AFE) is the largest exporter of Southern Bluefin Tuna in Australia. Our tuna is exported around the world for sale in international marketplaces as a premium sushi/sashimi product. We specialise in the fishing, ranching and grow out of Southern Bluefin Tuna and control the entire process from catching to feeding, harvesting, processing and delivery. 
This position is available from November 2026 or sooner for suitable candidates with a valid AMSA Near Coastal Marine Engine Driver Grade 2/3 Certification, for a placement for up to 4 years.
Vessel Engineer Duties:
The Employee will be required to perform certain duties as listed below whilst at Sea (offshore) and on the Farm Site (inshore), although this list is not exhaustive it is a generalised overview of duties.
Engineer Duties:
•	Engine Room Watchkeeping 
•	Periodical Engine Servicing
•	Maintain machinery to an Operational capacity
•	Use of Pumping Systems
•	Vessel Slipping and Docking
•	Vessel Maintenance/Repairs 
•	Vessel Crane Operation
•	Refuelling & Bunkering
•	Loading and Unloading of vessel at Sea and On-shore
•	Reporting to Vessel Master
•	Maintenance and repairs coordinated with Fleet Manager
•	Forklift operation on-shore only (if Licensed)
•	Fish Feeding 
•	Repetitive Manual labour 
•	Vessel cleaning and house keeping 
•	Vessel Mooring/Berthing 
•	Net mending 
•	Rope work (Splicing, Knotting etc.)
•	Farm Pontoon Maintenance
Also including Deck Hand duties:
Deckhand Duties:
•	Ability to stand on unstable surfaces and undertake general duties on a day-to-day basis as advised by the Master 
•	Forklift operation (only if Licensed from previous deployment on SWP)  onshore only
•	Loading and Unloading of vessel at Sea and On-shore
•	Deck Machinery Operation
•	Fish Feeding 
•	Fish Processing and Packing
•	Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
•	Repetitive Manual labour 
•	Vessel cleaning and house keeping 
•	Vessel Mooring/Berthing 
•	Net mending & Rope work (Splicing, Knotting etc.)
•	High Pressure Water Blasting
•	Painting by Hand and/or Spray
•	Farm Pontoon Maintenance
•	Portable hand tool use

The Employee will be required to perform the following additional duties whilst at Sea for Offshore Operations.
Navigation Watch:
• Keeping Lookout for other Vessels
• Maintaining Vessel Course as per Master’s instructions
• Vessel Log recording
• Watch Handover to next watch keeper
• Reporting to the Master
• Radio frequency monitoring
A Navigational watch can per performed at any time throughout the day or night, they are generally 1.5-2 hours in duration.

Additional Deck Duties:
• Tender vessel operation
• Launch and retrieval of tender
• Fish Sampling/Chumming
• Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
• Repetitive Manual labour
• Vessel cleaning and house keeping
• Vessel Mooring/Berthing
*This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the role.

Hours of operation are determined by the daily operational needs,.
January – July Operations are 7 days per week; you can work up to 6 days in a week. Up to 12 hours per day.
August to December Operations are 5 days per week Monday to Friday, you will work up to 5 days in a week, 8 hours per day.
Offshore Operations:
Tow & Support operations begin in December through to late March. If Quota is exhausted quickly the Offshore Operations will cease before late March.
Hours of operation whilst at Sea are from Sunrise to Sunset plus a navigational watch. 

Renumeration is paid as per the Award Rate, paid on a fortnightly basis. Farm work completed inshore and onshore will be calculated at the applicable hourly Farm rate. Aquaculture Award:(https://awards.fairwork.gov.au/MA000114.html)(https://calculate.fairwork.gov.au/payguides/fairwork/ma000114/pdf)
OFFSHORE OPERATIONS
An additional contract is put in place alongside original Deckhand Contract to cover the periods Offshore for Tow & Support operations to classify Duties and Remuneration (there is no Award that covers the "At Sea" roles), contract renumeration is calculated from experience and seamanship knowledge.

This is not a FIFO position. Successful applicants will need to based in Port Lincoln for the duration of the contracted period.

HammondCare provides expert aged care, home care, dementiacareand palliative care for older people, regardless of circumstances, beliefs,backgroundor financial situation. We are led by our not-for-profit, Christian foundations and backed by research and clinical expertise.

When it comes to our people - those we serve and those who serve - we are committed to inclusion across race, culture, ethnicity, gender, sex, sexuality,religionand ability. In our innovative residences, our hospitals, or in client homes, we aim to set the global standard of relationship-based care for older people with complex needs.

We've been caring for people for over 90 years - so, if you love to care, join us, and make a career move that matters.

It'snot just care.It'sHammondCare.

About The Role

At HammondCare, technology plays a critical role in improving quality of life for people with complex health and aged care needs.We'reseekingan experienced and strategic technology leader to join our executive team asGeneral Manager - DigitalProducts&Platforms.

This is a significant leadership role,reporting to the CIO, you will ownHammondCare'sdigitalplatforms &productscapability, leading the teams responsible for building, evolving, and optimising the platforms that underpin care delivery, workforce productivity, business operations, and future innovation.

You'llhelp shape a modern product and platform operating model, bringing together product management, engineering, agile delivery, platform operations, architecture alignment, vendor management, and value realisation into a single, high-performing capability.

This is an opportunity to lead digital transformation at scale while ensuring our core platformsremainreliable, secure, integrated, and ready to support emerging AI and automation opportunities.

This is apermanentroleworking at St Leonards with hybrid opportunities.

Responsibilities

Define and execute the strategy and roadmap forHammondCare'sdigital products, platforms, and enterprise systems, ensuring alignment to organisational priorities and future growth

Lead multiple agile squads across Salesforce, ERP, care systems, integration services, and digital experience platforms, creating a high-performing delivery culture focused on outcomes

Establish and evolve a modern productand platform operating model that aligns product management, engineering, delivery, support, and business teams around customer value

Drive engineering excellence through Agile, DevOps, automation, quality engineering, secure-by-design principles, and modern delivery practices

Lead product adoption, platform utilisation, and benefits realisation, ensuring technology investments deliver measurable business and operational outcomes

Partner with Data, AI & Analytics leaders toestablishAI-ready platforms, ensuring the foundations for analytics, automation, and responsible AI adoption are in place

Lead strategic vendor, partner, and software supplier relationships, ensuring strong commercial outcomes, innovation, and value for money

About you

15+ years' experience leading enterprise technology products, platforms, digital services, or engineering organisations 

Demonstrated success leading large multidisciplinary teams across product, platform, engineering, delivery, and operational functions 

Experienceestablishingand scaling modern product and platform operating models 

Strong experience across enterprise platforms such as CRM, ERP, digital workplace, and care or customer-facing systems

What we can offer you

We care about your wellbeing at HammondCare and as a result offer a wide range of health and lifestyle benefits including:

NFP salary packaging ($15,900 tax free) plus meals and entertainment benefit (up to $2,650 tax free) 

Additional leave purchase options and 14 weeks paid parental leave 

Flexible working options 

Discounts on everyday products and services 

Discounted healthcare memberships - access to network of fitness centres and pools for employees and families 

Free access to independent counselling support for employees and families 

Health & Wellbeing programmes 

Reward & Recognition programmes 

Referral bonuses 

Career and professional development opportunities 

Our Culture

HammondCare is committed to creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity and inclusion. We strive to create an equal employment environment for all.

Ifyou'rea strategic technology leader who can combine vision, execution, engineering excellence, and business value delivery,we'dlove to hear from you.

If you are ready to make a difference with HammondCare, Apply Now!
